work: Kavvathas & Konstantopoulos: Resilient distributed control ... capability curve requirements
verification_level: A (full text read: abstract, intro, model, invariance, stability, resilience, simulations)
system_model: Nonlinear multimachine; 4th-order SG model; inverter DERs; network DAE
hypotheses: Neighbour-to-neighbour communication; initial set-points in int W_i
constraints_and_where_enforced: Capability curve W_i on controller set-points (Pset Qset); not on delivered output
math_guarantees: Forward invariance of W_i by Nagumo/vector-field argument; closed-loop stability by eigenvalue analysis over gain ranges (numerical); resilience when units saturate
regulation_f_V: f restoration; P and Q sharing
scale_and_test_system: 10-bus (4 SG + 2 DER) and 14-bus (low X/R) systems; HIL
experimental_evidence: Simulation and HIL vs saturated integral controller sIC
relation_to_our_results: Our B2. Overlap: reference-set invariance (our T1) and eigenvalue-based stability. Not covered there: post-event jump admissibility of delivered outputs; dispatch design; centering on a post-event equilibrium; sampled-data analysis

work: Kavvathas Konstantopoulos Konstantinou: Resilient distributed integral control ... inherent input constraint satisfaction
Wang & Chen: Distributed coordination of GFM and GFL inverters for optimal frequency control
verification_level: A (full text read: abstract, intro, constraint handling, stability proof, simulation setup)
system_model: Linear DC power flow and simplified IBR model for design; EMT validation (MATLAB/Simulink; full-order SG in the hybrid case)
hypotheses: Deviations from nominal set by the latest economic dispatch (Remark 2)
constraints_and_where_enforced: IBR capacity limits (time-varying) and line thermal limits; global projection keeps power references within feasible sets during transients; physical outputs not constrained
math_guarantees: Lyapunov/LaSalle asymptotic stability of projected primal-dual dynamics (stated by the authors as a first for global projection)
preventive_dispatch: None; takes the dispatch as nominal
scale_and_test_system: Modified IEEE 39-bus (100% IBR and hybrid with SG) EMT
experimental_evidence: Simulation; tests with delays and time-varying limits
relation_to_our_results: Same test network family. Constraint guarantee is at reference level like our T1; no admissibility-at-event analysis; linear design model

work: Mo & Liu: Multi-slot distributed frequency control with heterogeneous devices
verification_level: A (full text read: abstract, intro, model, theorem statements, simulation setup)
system_model: SG with first-order turbine-governor; structure-preserving network (linearised); ESU and controllable loads
hypotheses: Accurate net-load forecasts over a prediction window; Assumption 1
constraints_and_where_enforced: Device capacity constraints by projected PDGD throughout transients and at steady state; on set-points
math_guarantees: Existence/uniqueness of Caratheodory solutions; local asymptotic stability (Remark 2); ISS bound
preventive_dispatch: Embedded multi-slot economic dispatch (optimisation inside the controller); not a preventive dispatch against the event jump
scale_and_test_system: Modified IEEE 118-bus (54 SG 30 ESU 40 CLD 30 REG)
relation_to_our_results: Capacity guarantee at set-point level (our T1 analogue); local stability (our T2 analogue); no jump admissibility

work: Mo & Liu: Distributed frequency control for multi-area systems considering transient frequency safety
verification_level: A (full text read: model, assumptions, Theorem 3)
system_model: Aggregated area linearised swing equation; lossless ties; constant voltage; constant-power loads
hypotheses: Initial frequency inside the safe set for safe forward invariance; otherwise finite-time entry without explicit bound (Remark 12)
constraints_and_where_enforced: Frequency safe set by CBF corrector; generation capacity on mechanical power

relation_to_our_results: Closest precedent for a barrier corrector on a secondary controller; therefore the CLF-CBF-QP cannot be claimed as novel. Our setting differs (DAE with voltage/reactive limits and an algebraic jump)
